title: Let Them Steal: Trapping Large Language Model Extraction Attacks with Knowledge Honeypot
abstract: arXiv:2606.15810v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models deployed as commercial APIs are vulnerable to model extraction attacks, while existing defenses either act too late or degrade utility for legitimate users. We propose \textbf{Knowledge Trap}, a defense that redirects extraction attacks toward low-transferability knowledge through a \emph{Honeypot Knowledge Graph} (HKG) and breadcrumb-guided exploration. Instead of blocking queries or perturbing outputs, Knowledge Trap consumes the attacker's limited query budget on knowledge with negligible downstream utility while preserving benign-user performance. Experiments in medical and financial domains show that Knowledge Trap reduces surrogate Agreement by 6.2\% on average without degrading legitimate-user accuracy, outperforming existing defenses that impose measurable user impact. These results suggest that defending knowledge-space traversal is a practical direction for mitigating LLM extraction attacks.

translated_title: 让它们偷：用知识蜜罐诱捕大型语言模型提取攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.15810v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：作为商业API部署的大型语言模型容易受到模型提取攻击，而现有的防御措施要么反应过迟，要么降低了对合法用户的效用。我们提出了“知识陷阱”，这是一种通过“蜜罐知识图谱”（HKG）和面包屑引导探索将提取攻击重定向至低迁移性知识的防御方法。知识陷阱不阻止查询或扰动输出，而是消耗攻击者有限的查询预算于下游效用可忽略的知识上，同时保持良性用户性能。在医疗和金融领域的实验中，知识陷阱平均将替代模型的一致性降低了6.2%，且不损害合法用户的准确性，优于那些对用户造成可衡量影响的现有防御措施。这些结果表明，防御知识空间遍历是缓解LLM提取攻击的一个实用方向。
tldr: 知识陷阱通过蜜罐知识图谱和面包屑引导，将提取攻击引向低价值知识，在保持合法用户性能的同时，平均降低替代模型一致性6.2%，优于现有防御方法。
